card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a $12,500 claimer. Four horses want the front, so the early fractions should be honest. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 5 points.
card_reads.shape: Four of the 8 are entitled to the early lead, so the opening quarter over five and a half furlongs on dirt in a $12,500 claimer should be contested rather than soft. Our pace adjustment credits #1 Cotta Ride and #3 Pride Of Queens on that basis.

card_reads.read: An open heat. Nothing separates the top two by more than 2.5 points. Three of them want the lead. The barn's angle in this exact spot is among the best in the field. We make the favourite, #7 BAYTOWN BUTTERFLY, 17% against the board's 23%, shorter than we think it should be. We are not betting the race; take it as an opinion, not a play.
